mapper.sql: select ss.id, ss.staff_id, ss.shop_id, ss.is_default, ss.create_time, u.account, u.nickname, u.phone, u.status as staff_status from staff_shop ss inner join shop_staff u on u.id = ss.staff_id and u.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: where ss.shop_id = #{shopId} order by ss.is_default desc, ss.id asc

select s.id as shop_id, s.shop_code, s.name as shop_name, concat_ws('', s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address) as address, s.status, ss.is_default from staff_shop ss inner join shop s on s.id = ss.shop_id and s.del_flag = 0 where ss.staff_id = #{staffId} order by ss.is_default desc, s.sort_order asc, s.id asc
select count(1) from staff_shop where staff_id = #{staffId}
mapper.insert: insert into staff_shop (staff_id, shop_id, is_default, create_time) values (#{staffId}, #{shopId}, #{isDefault}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update staff_shop set is_default = 0 where staff_id = #{staffId} and is_default = 1
mapper.delete: delete from staff_shop where shop_id = #{shopId} and staff_id = #{staffId}
